verdict.rationale: The README describes llama.cpp as a "plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies" and points to building from source by cloning the repo with a dedicated build guide. Community users independently praise not needing "a billion python/c/cpp dependencies", note it is detached from the Python ML ecosystem, and report compiling it from source successfully and easily. missing for 10: the build guide's actual toolchain requirements (e.g., build system, compiler versions, extra SDKs needed for GPU backends) are not detailed in the evidence.
